commands.petbees.help: /petbees count or watch: all loaded dimensions; append nearby: within 32 blocks of you; /petbees watch off: stop
commands.petbees.count: Your bees [loaded, all dimensions]: %s (outside %s, in hives %s, including babies)
commands.petbees.live: Bees [loaded, all dimensions]: %s | Outside %s | In hives %s | Change %s
commands.petbees.scope: Living bees in loaded areas across all dimensions, updated about once per second. Unloaded chunks and bees stored in items are excluded. A decrease can mean unloading or picking up a hive, not necessarily death or lost ownership. Use /petbees count nearby or /petbees watch nearby for bees within 32 blocks of you.
commands.petbees.watch_started: Live bee count enabled above the hotbar. Use /petbees watch off to stop.
commands.petbees.nearby: Your bees [within 32 blocks, current dimension]: %s | Outside %s | In hives %s (includes babies)
